traces.title: Flat ground: 12-step acceleration to run_speed, 8-step deceleration to zero, no Y drift
Held jump: edge at step 12, apex gain vs theory, landing back at rest height
Variable height: release at step 14 halves the ascending velocity
Buffer: press while airborne, land at step 18, the buffered jump fires at step 19 (the last buffered step)
Buffer: press while airborne, land 33 steps later, no buffered jump
Coyote: ground removed after step 14, press at the 6th airborne step (21) still jumps
Coyote: the same press one step later (22) cannot jump
No air jump: a second press while airborne never restores jump velocity
Wall: 4 m/s run stops at face - (radius + skin); intent keeps running, no wall jump
Head: jump from a 1.0 m platform under a 3.58 m ceiling; upward velocity clamped at contact
Ledge: 0.4 m step blocks walking (no autostep); a running jump lands on the ledge top
12 m/s approach: the sweep stops the character with no tunnelling
2.5D: X/Y move while position.z, rotation and scale stay bit-identical
Seam: crossing a 2 cm floor gap keeps the character grounded (0 ungrounded steps; contract allows <= 2)
Snap: a 0.06 m step down (< 0.1 m snap) is absorbed while walking; the character never goes airborne
Snap limit: a 0.15 m step down (> 0.1 m snap) makes the character fall and land on the lower floor
